name: Optimizely Campaign
author: optimizelycampaign

sections.description:
Optimizely Campaign integrates seamlessly with your store and lets you manage your transactional mail operations in one place. Leverage real-time customer data synchronization to create personalized campaigns and boost conversions.
With this plugin, you can easily select which transactional emails should be sent via Optimizely Campaign and which should use the default mail service. In addition to that, you can add a newsletter form for guest subscribers to any page or post through a custom shortcode provided by the plugin and the submission will be handled via Optimizely Campaign. Newsletter subscribing is also
possible through the WooCommerce registration form and account details form for WooCommerce customers.

Highlights

Streamlined Transactional Mailings: Send crucial transactional messages directly through your Optimizely Campaign client. This ensures that order confirmations, account notifications, and other vital emails reach customers reliably.
Automated Subscriber Management: Seamlessly synchronize your newsletter subscribers so your contact lists are always current. Stay organized and focus on creating effective marketing campaigns.

Features

Transactional Mail Integration
Integrate Optimizely Campaign to effortlessly send all your transactional mailings from one platform. Improve communication flow and maintain consistent branding.
Subscriber Synchronization
Automatically keep your mailing lists in sync, ensuring that every new subscriber or unsubscribed contact is promptly updated in your database.

  • == External services ==
  • This plugin connects to the Optimizely HTTP API to synchronize the data of customers who have subscribed to the newsletter with double opt-in.
  • It updates the subscribed customer’s data every time the customer makes a change to their account. The data that gets synchronized can be configured in the plugin page.
  • In addition to that, the plugin connects to the Optimizely SMTP API to send out transactional mails.
  • This service is provided by “Optimizely Inc”: Privacy Policy
  • The plugin connects to the Optimizely Campaign API at Optimizely Campaign API

Usage Instructions

Step 1: Configure Optimizely Mail Settings and Default Mail Settings =

To start using the plugin, navigate to the Mail Settings tab and enter your Optimizely SMTP credentials + default
mail service details.

The Optimizely Mail Configuration section sets the mail settings for email events that will be sent through
Optimizely Campaign.
The Default Mail Configuration section sets the mail settings for email events that will be sent through the default
mail service in WordPress. The Default From Email and the Default From Name have initial values and should only be updated if you are certain that
you need to use a different From Email address.

Filling out these settings is necessary to start sending emails through Optimizely Campaign.

Step 2: Set Up Newsletter Settings

Set up your Opt-in Process in Optimizely Campaign and make sure that Confirmation Page URL includes the bmrecipientid
** and **bmrecipientlistid query parameters.
Once the Opt-in Process is set up, go to the Newsletter Settings tab in the Optimizely Campaign plugin page, provide
the necessary information for newsletter processing. The necessary information is a recipient list authorization code
and an opt-in process id from Optimizely Campaign.
After the recipient list information is defined, you can select which data fields from WordPress/WooCommerce are synced to Optimizely Campaign.

Step 3: Select Transactional Mails for SMTP Delivery =

Once your SMTP settings are configured, go to the respective WP Core Event Settings, WooCommerce Event Settings
and Other Event Settings tabs and select the event emails you want to send via Optimizely Campaign. The unselected
events will go through the default WordPress mail service.

Step 4: Add the Newsletter Form to a Page or Post =

After configuring the newsletter settings, copy the shortcode provided by the plugin and paste it into any page or post
where you want the newsletter subscription form to appear.

The plugin provides a shortcode that renders a newsletter form.

Shortcode

Description: This shortcode adds a newsletter form to your page or post. The newsletter form is used for the guest subscribers.

[optimizelycampaign_newsletter]

Step 5: Create a Newsletter Confirmation Page

Create a new page on your site that will serve as the confirmation page users will be redirected to after confirming
their subscription via email. Ensure the Confirmation Page URL set up in your Optimizely client matches the URL of the
confirmation page set up in your site.

Step 6: Start Accepting Subscriptions

With the newsletter settings, newsletter form and confirmation page in place, visitors to your site can now subscribe
and unsubscribe to your newsletter seamlessly whether they\’re a guest or a WooCommerce customer.
sections.installation:
1. Install through the “WordPress Plugin Directory” or upload the plugin in zip format.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How can I use this plugin in combination with WooCommerce?

You can select to send the WooCommerce transactional mails through Optimizely Campaign. In addition to that, WooCommerce customers have the option to subscribe to the newsletter through the registration form or the account details form.

What fields should the Optimizely recipient list contain for synchronization of data?

You can map the recipient list fields to the WP user fields in the Newsletter Settings tab.

What should the slug for the newsletter confirmation page be?

The slug should be /optimizelycampaign. And it should be the same in the Optimizely Campaign Client.
